name: Detroit Edible | 200mg Barracuda Bar | Crispy Milk Chocolate
description: Barracuda Milk Chocolate Crispy Bars are crafted from the highest-quality ingredients. The chocolate is made of 65% Belgian chocolate combined with the purest distillate from our very own Michigan-made Cannalicious Labs for the smoothest consumption experience to date. Plus, we’ve added crispy rice cereal for the perfect amount of crunch in every bite.
